name: Artisan Craft
description:
ArtisanCraft – Luxury Wallpaper & Custom Wall Design Studio

ArtisanCraft is a premium wallpaper and wall décor studio specializing in luxury wallpapers, custom wall murals, designer wall panels, and waterproof wall coverings for homes, offices, hotels, and retail spaces. Our curated collections include modern, textured, artistic, and handcrafted wallpaper designs that transform walls into statement interiors.

We collaborate with homeowners, architects, and interior designers to deliver customized wall solutions that combine design, durability, and craftsmanship. If you are looking for designer wallpaper, custom murals, or premium wall décor, Artisan Craft offers creative solutions to elevate your interiors.

featured_reviews.name: Chirag Badkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Lamington Road in Mumbai is one of the most famous electronic markets in India. It is a one-stop destination for all kinds of electronic goods, computer parts, mobile accessories, cables, chips, tools, and repair items. From students and technicians to engineers and business owners, people from all over the city visit Lamington Road for its wide variety of products and competitive prices.

The market is well known for both retail and wholesale purchases. You can find the latest components as well as rare or older electronic parts that are difficult to get elsewhere. Many shops also offer repair services, custom assembly, and technical guidance, making it a very useful place for electronics enthusiasts.

Though the area is usually crowded and busy, it has a unique charm. Lamington Road truly reflects Mumbai’s fast-paced spirit and is a must-visit place for anyone interested in electronics and technology.

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Masih
featured_reviews.review_text: Place to purchase Different types of electronic items, devices, Machineries, LED screens' equipments, also lights, sound etc.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Bhalerao
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Lamington Electric Market on Grant Road, Mumbai, and was thoroughly impressed by the wide range of electrical supplies they offer. The market is a haven for anyone in need of electrical components, tools, and equipment. The variety and quality of products available here are truly commendable.

The market's layout is well-organized, making it easy to navigate and locate specific items. The knowledgeable and friendly staff members were more than willing to assist, making my shopping experience pleasant and efficient. Whether you're a professional electrician or a DIY enthusiast, you'll find everything you need under one roof.

What stands out about Lamington Electric Market is the competitive pricing. The prices are reasonable, especially considering the quality of products they offer. It's a one-stop destination for all your electrical requirements, saving you both time and money.

My only minor critique would be the parking facilities, which can get a bit congested due to the market's popularity. Nonetheless, this shouldn't deter you from visiting this fantastic electrical marketplace.

Lamington Electric Market is a hidden gem for electrical supplies in Mumbai. Its extensive selection, helpful staff, and affordable prices make it a must-visit for anyone seeking top-notch electrical components. I highly recommend this market to professionals and enthusiasts alike!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Maria Decor  was recommended to me by someone I know personally name called Rajsekhar ,  He showed me his latest renderings and I was blown away by how professional it all looked. I looked into the service and found it to be little expensive priced but no compromise on quality  and thought that it was worth a trial run. I decided to start with my office which I believe is likely my most difficult project as I wanted a lot of very functional builtins for crafting but also wanted it to look elegant and not all "crafty". My designer was amazing. He listened to my needs and wants. Any and all feedback was thoughtfully considered and addressed. My final products like louvers ASA sheets  is perfect. It is incredibly functional while also elegant and stylish. It reflects my style because he listened to me. I've used interior products  before and, while products  were perfectly nice individuals, it seemed they were trying impose *their* vision on *my* space. My Maria Decor representative managed to take my vision and make it even better. He came up with solutions to meet my needs that I had never considered! And, when I wasn't in love with something he selected or proposed, he was incredibly professional and adaptable. There were times when my wants or ideas weren't realistic or there was a best product  solution. He patiently and professionally walked me through his thinking each time I had questions or concerns. Honestly, it was such a pleasant process. I'm not sure I could ask for anything more! I'll be using Maria Decor  for many more projects! This service is an incredible value. I would have paid more for the service and product I received in the quality and various designs, but I'm not sure I would have initially tried the service if it had been priced much higher. I am extremely satisfied and will happily tell others about my experience. ”!
Use Maria Decor
